title: SBI KYC Fraud Alert
summary: SBI warns customers about fake SMS claiming account will be deactivated unless KYC is updated via a link. SBI never sends such links.
recommendation: SBI does not send KYC update links. Report such messages to report@sbi.co.in. Block and report the sender.

title: HDFC Bank Phishing Alert
summary: Fraud SMS impersonating HDFC Bank asking customers to click links for reward points or cashback. Links lead to fake HDFC login pages.
recommendation: HDFC never asks for login credentials via SMS. Access net banking only through hdfcbank.com. Report phishing to phishing@hdfcbank.com.
